message.content:
I don’t have real‑time access to weather data, so I can’t give you the current forecast for London right now.  
If you’d like up‑to‑date information, you can check one of the following:

| Service | How to use |
|---------|------------|
| **Weather.com** | Go to https://weather.com/, type “London” in the search bar. |
| **BBC Weather** | Visit https://www.bbc.co.uk/weather/, enter “London”. |
| **OpenWeatherMap API** | If you’re a developer, you can call the API: `https://api.openweathermap.org/data/2.5/weather?q=London&appid=YOUR_API_KEY`. |
| **Google Search** | Just type “London weather” into Google and the quick‑view card will show the current temperature, conditions, and a short forecast. |

If you need a quick snapshot right now, let me know and I can give you a typical example of what London’s weather might look like (e.g., “It’s usually around 12 °C with light rain in late March”).
message.reasoning: User asks: "what's the weather in london". We need to provide weather info. We don't have real-time data. We can say we can't fetch live data. We can suggest using a weather API or website. We can also provide a generic example. Probably best to explain limitations.
